issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires Farm.animals to be a List implemented using an ArrayList and initialized in the no-arg constructor. The provided solution instead declares animals as a Set<Animal> and initializes it with a HashSet, which conflicts with the assignment's specified collection type and intended teaching point about using a List/ArrayList.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement by changing the Farm.animals declaration and related API to use List<Animal> and initialize it with a new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor. Update getter/setter and any usages (addAnimal, iteration in feedAllAnimals and singFarmSong) to operate on List<Animal> so the implementation matches the exercise instructions.
